synopsis.text: The Avengers, hurtled through time at the hands of Kang! Earth’s Mightiest Heroes find themselves neck-deep in a rescue mission…in ancient Egypt! Will Thor, Iron Man, and Vision be saved from Kang’s Macrobots? A revelation about Mantis’ true identity tears the time stream in two. An Avenger falls in battle.
Note: After an original Avengers story, there are two reprint stories from Fantastic Four #19.
